comparison_model.identity: one-net non-interpenetrated counterpart of the deposited structure
comparison_model.construction: from the deposited periodic structure, identify the two chemically identical, translationally interwoven tfz nets and retain exactly one complete net; preserve the crystallographic cell and all retained atoms; document atom mapping and net count

boundary.relaxation: atomic coordinates may be optimized; cell must not be optimized
boundary.observable: electronic total energy normalized per net, reported in kcal mol-1 per net

independence: Choose software, electronic-structure model and convergence settings independently; do not use the paper or SI.
